summary: Feed s143_double is degraded: VLAN 20 missing (50% of packets untagged) and IDS port overloaded by microbursts to 1.53 Gbps (153% of 1 Gbps capacity) across 5 intervals.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream TAP/SPAN trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20; 50% of packets arrive untagged so required VLAN 20 is invisible at the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS has no visibility into VLAN 20, missing lateral movement, segmentation violations and VLAN-based correlation; detection coverage effectively halved for required VLANs [10,20].

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the packet broker to restore full segmentation visibility for the IDS.

findings.root_cause: Aggregate burst rate of 1.53 Gbps in 1 ms exceeds the single 1 Gbps IDS port capacity (153% of capacity, 5 intervals over 80% threshold); packet broker is not load-balancing or shaping bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS ingress buffers overrun and silently drop packets during bursts, breaking TCP reassembly and causing missed signatures and blind spots for burst-borne attacks despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic with flow-aware 5-tuple hashing across 2+ IDS ports to keep per-port utilization below 80% and absorb 1.53 Gbps microbursts without drops.
